title: Password Reset Policy
text: Employees can reset their password through the company identity portal. Multifactor authentication is required to complete the reset.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
text: Employees must submit expense reimbursement requests within 30 days of the purchase. Receipts are required for expenses over 25 dollars.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees working remotely must use the corporate VPN when accessing internal systems. Devices must have disk encryption enabled.

title: Data Handling Policy
text: Customer personal information must not be included in public AI prompts. Sensitive data must be masked before external model processing.

title: Support Escalation
text: Urgent production incidents should be reported to the on-call support engineer. High severity incidents require an incident ticket and status updates.
